'''Virginie Bonnaillie-Noël''' (born 3 October 1976 in [[Calais]]) is a French mathematician and research director specializing in [[numerical analysis]]. Her research topics concern partial differential equations, asymptotic, spectral and numerical analysis of problems arising from physics or mechanics.

== Life and work ==
After completing her preparatory classes at Faidherbe high school in [[Lille]] between 1994 and 1997, Bonnaillie-Noël entered [[Paris-Sud University]] where she obtained a bachelor's degree in 1998 and a master's degree in 1999. The same year, she was admitted to the [[École normale supérieure Paris-Saclay|Ecole Normale Supérieure Paris-Saclay]] (ENS) where she obtained the aggregation in 2000 with the option of numerical analysis. In 2001, she obtained a Diploma of Advanced Studies (DEA) in Numerical Analysis and Partial Differential Equations.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2009 |title=PRIX DE LA JEUNE FEMME SCIENTIFIQUE, Virginie BONNAILLIE-NOËL |url=https://archive.wikiwix.com/cache/index2.php?url=http%3A%2F%2Fcache.media.enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr%2Ffile%2F2009%2F83%2F1%2Fdosp_def3_63831.pdf |access-date=2022-07-22}}</ref><ref name=":1" />

Between 2001 and 2003 she completed a thesis (as Virginie Bonnaillie) under the supervision of François Alouges and [[Bernard Helffer]] titled ''Mathematical analysis of superconductivity in a corner domain: semi-classical and numerical methods,'' which explored [[interdisciplinarity]] between physics and mathematics, at the border of numerical analysis, partial differential equations and [[spectral theory]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |last=Bonnaillie |first=Virginie |title=Thesis |url=https://archive.wikiwix.com/cache/index2.php?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.math.ens.fr%2F%7Ebonnaillie%2Farticles%2FTheseBo03.pdf%2Findex.html#federation=archive.wikiwix.com}}</ref>

In 2004, she joined the Mathematical Research Institute of Rennes (IRMAR) as a research fellow. In 2011, she obtained authorization to direct research at the [[University of Rennes 1|University of Rennes I]]. In 2014, she left IRMAR to direct research in the Mathematics and Applications Department of ENS.<ref name=":0" />

In addition to her official work, Bonnaillie-Noël has frequently spoken about gender parity in science and research to encourage more young people to participate in the sciences.<ref name=":0" />

== Distinctions ==
* 2008: [[French National Centre for Scientific Research|CNRS]] bronze medal<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=INSMI - Institut national des sciences mathématiques et de leurs interactions - Remise de la médaille de bronze du CNRS à Virginie Bonnaillie-Noël |url=https://archive.wikiwix.com/cache/index2.php?url=http://www.cnrs.fr/insmi/spip.php?article122#federation=archive.wikiwix.com |access-date=2022-07-22 |website=archive.wikiwix.com}}</ref>
* 2009: [[Irène Joliot-Curie Prize|Irène-Joliot-Curie Prize]] in the young female scientist category<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Les lauréates du Prix Irène Joliot-Curie 2009 - ESR : enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr |url=http://www.enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr/cid28697/les-laureates-du-prix-irene-joliot-curie-2009.html |access-date=2022-07-22 |website=www.enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr |language=fr}}</ref>
* 2011: Chevalier of the National Order of Merit by [[Cédric Villani]]<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Jeune |first=Cecile Le |date=September 11, 2012 |title=ENS Rennes - Remise de l'insigne de Chevalier de l'Ordre National du mérite à Virginie Bonnaillie-Noël par Cédric Villani |url=http://www.ens-rennes.fr/actualites/remise-de-l-insigne-de-chevalier-de-l-ordre-national-du-merite-a-virginie-bonnaillie-noel-par-cedric-villani-160399.kjsp?RH=1183619720582 |access-date=2022-07-22 |website=ENS Rennes |language=fr-FR}}</ref>
* 2021: Officer of the National Order of Merit<ref>{{Cite web |title=Promotions |url=https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/jorf/id/JORFTEXT000042846616 |access-date=2022-07-22 |website=www.legifrance.gouv.fr}}</ref>

== Selected publications ==
* Bonnaillie-Noël, V., & Dauge, M. (2006, August). Asymptotics for the low-lying eigenstates of the Schrödinger operator with magnetic field near corners. In ''Annales Henri Poincaré'' (Vol. 7, No. 5, pp.&nbsp;899–931). Birkhäuser-Verlag.
* Bonnaillie-Noël, V., & Fournais, S. (2007). Superconductivity in domains with corners. ''Reviews in Mathematical Physics'', ''19''(06), 607-637.
* Bonnaillie-Noël, V., Dambrine, M., Tordeux, S., & Vial, G. (2009). Interactions between moderately close inclusions for the Laplace equation. ''Mathematical Models and Methods in Applied Sciences'', ''19''(10), 1853-1882.
* Bonnaillie-Noël, V., Dambrine, M., Hérau, F., & Vial, G. (2010). On generalized Ventcel's type boundary conditions for [[Laplace operator]] in a bounded domain. ''SIAM journal on mathematical analysis'', ''42''(2), 931-945.
* Bonnaillie-Noël, V., Helffer, B., & Vial, G. (2010). Numerical simulations for nodal domains and spectral minimal partitions. ''ESAIM: Control, Optimisation and Calculus of Variations'', ''16''(1), 221-246.
